title: A trailing tab whose default stop lies past the right edge opens a blank line; a tab ending on the last in-column stop does not
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-28): Letter 1125 margins (column 9990 twips), Arial 11 line 240 (12.48/12.72 alternating), text ending at ~2594 twips; 11 tabs + 20 spaces: baselines 82.32 -> next paragraph 107.52 (two lines); 10 tabs + spaces: 107.52 -> 120.24 (one line); 11 tabs + 'end': 'end' at x 36 on a second line (132.96 -> 145.44 -> LAST 158.16); 10 tabs + 'end': 'end' at x 468 on the same line (170.88 -> TAIL 183.36)

cases.note: eleventh tab past the edge + spaces: two lines
tenth tab on 9360 + spaces: one line, the spaces hang
eleventh tab past the edge + 'end': Word wraps the tab and 'end' lands on the first stop of a second line; gen pins it flush right on one line
